subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellLevel3: Return if ShellCommandLineParse() failed
reasons: Applies the same structural transformation — early return on ShellCommandLineParse() error instead of wrapping the rest of the function in an else block — across 9 files in the same library

The before/after pattern is well-defined: replace 'if (EFI_ERROR(Status)) { ... } else { <body> ShellCommandLineFreeVarList(Package); }' with 'if (EFI_ERROR(Status)) { return ...; } <body> ShellCommandLineFreeVarList(Package);'
High repetitiveness: the identical guard pattern appears in every ShellCommandRunXXX() function across the library
candidate_pattern: Match ShellCommandLineParse() call followed by error check that wraps remaining function body in else branch; transform to early return on error, moving body out of else at top level. Applies to each ShellCommandRunXXX() function that follows this structure.
